legend.transitReach.uncoveredGrid: Not covered (unreachable within 12 h or no data; not zero)
legend.transitReach.rulePop: Classes: quantiles of all cells, in people.
legend.transitReach.ruleHub: Classes: minutes to the nearest major station.
legend.transitReach.gainNote: Gain = all modes minus drive-only; under 10 min counts as no difference.
legend.transitReach.gridCaliber: Idealised scenario, not measured; outlying-island schedules not modelled. Data: OSM (ODbL), GHSL (CC BY 4.0), TDX.
legend.transitReach.noMode: "{name}" has no data for this mode combination; try another mode.
legend.transitReach.stepsAuto: Scale: auto (farthest reach from this origin, {h} h); 15-min steps for the first 2 h, then 30 min.
legend.transitReach.stepsFixed: Scale: fixed {h} h; 15-min steps for the first 2 h, then 30 min.
legend.transitReach.front: During playback only cells already reached are drawn; isochrones every full hour.
legend.transitReach.playbackCaliber: Idealised scenario, not measured; excludes waiting and transfer delays. Data: OSM (ODbL), GHSL (CC BY 4.0), TDX.
legend.transitReach.error.http: Failed to load simulation data (HTTP error).
legend.transitReach.error.sha_mismatch: Simulation data checksum mismatch; loading stopped.
legend.transitReach.error.size_mismatch: Simulation data size mismatch; loading stopped.
legend.transitReach.error.path: Invalid simulation data path; loading stopped.
legend.transitReach.error.not_listed: Simulation file not in the manifest; loading stopped.
